title: carum alpestre
intro: Carum alpestre, commonly known as Wild Caraway, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and as an antispasmodic agent. The health benefits of Carum alpestre include its ability to alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and flu, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Carum alpestre include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
